statement: The control plane refuses a platform policy whose id a tenant document already defines or binds (422), naming those documents, confirmed by reading their heads; a tenant that only defines the id never keeps the platform from removing its own policy of that id.
guards: control:ChangesB1Test#the platform cannot add an id a tenant uses, and one that only defines it never blocks a removal - RC1-9
control:ReferenceFlagsTest#an addition is blocked by a tenant that binds the id, at the check and at publish
